lede: Nothing crossed all seventeen feeds today, so the loudest signal came from one source standing alone. On Wikipedia, the wrestler Pac pulled 806,988 reads, roughly two and a half times the runner-up, Lizzie Borden, who has been dead for nearly a century. Underneath that the web went quiet and technical: a fully local ElevenLabs alternative topping GitHub, a home-trained 0.8B model leading Hacker News, and a scatter of magnitude-5 earthquakes with no throughline tying them together.

throughlines.title: Pac (wrestler)
throughlines.gist: The day's most-read article anywhere at 806,988 views, more than double any other topic on Wikipedia.

throughlines.gist: A fully local, open-source ElevenLabs alternative that took the top of GitHub trending with 3,221 stars in a day.

throughlines.gist: A Jev-compatible 0.8B decision model trained at home at roughly 30 ms, leading Hacker News with 405 points and 154 comments.
